qa_cases.question: What changed on the PSV valve?

known_failure_cases: Content that moves further than align.max_bbox_distance (75pt) between revisions is reported as a remove + add instead of a modify, since alignment requires page + type + nearby position before comparing text.
The different_systems sample pair (two unrelated compressor drawings) produces a large, not-meaningful delta; it is kept as an honest edge case, not scored here.
